['S\u00fcdzucker AG '].company_description: Südzucker AG is a German company and the largest sugar producer in the world, with an annual production of around 4.8 million tonnes. It is involved in the production, processing, and marketing of sugars, primarily sucrose and fructose, and its products are used in a wide range of food and beverage applications.

['Agravis Raiffeisen AG '].company_description: Agravis Raiffeisen AG is a German agricultural trading and service company.
